newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yields fall, 6-mo yields rise.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-mo T-bill yields fall, 6-mo yields rise.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills edged down to 45.96 percent from 49.37 percent at the last sale on November 14, a central bank statement said on Monday.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 35.867 million UAH 79,000 UAH Average yield 45.96 pct 49.37 pct
The central bank sold 399,751 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 19.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills rose to 57.23 percent from 50.33 percent at the last sale on November 14, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 1.885 million UAH 5.78 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.146 million UAH 4.62 million UAH
The central bank sold 18,850 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 19. --Kiev newsroom +380 44 229-2264
